intents.reply: I'm Kernel, the agent every HQ comes with. I explain how Agenthix works, tell you what's happening across Fernhill & Co's projects, and make or start tasks for you in your space.

phrasings: How do I create a project?
intents.reply: Select New project, give it a name, and a key follows: two to six capital letters that start every task's number, like WEB in WEB-1. Choose whether it's for the organisation or just you, then Create project; you become its first administrator. Website relaunch is a good one to look around first, to see a project with tasks, a board and Knowledge.

In a real HQ an admin opens Manage, then People and invitations, selects Invite, chooses the person's role and first projects, and sends them the link; Agenthix sends no email. In this demo you're a member who can look but not invite, and you can see in People that Robin Ellis has an invitation waiting.
Website relaunch goes live in three weeks, with the home page copy waiting on an approval. Customer research is summarising interviews, and the quarterly report is being drafted.

intents.reply: Every tool is set to Always, Ask or Never, and Ask means a person approves it first. That's why WEB-2 is waiting in Website relaunch: Writer asked to read three competitor pages, and Priya decides.
